# Ladder operators — literature claims

Claims from wiphy.org, merging into `Physlib.QuantumMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.LadderOperators`.

claims.name: ladderOperator_generalizes_annihilation
claims.statement: The ladder-operator method generalizes the annihilation-operator technique for coherent states of symmetry systems.

claims.name: repulsiveOscillator_ladder_solutions
claims.statement: The repulsive-oscillator ladder-operator formalism reproduces the known analytic solutions.

sources.title: Ladder Operators in Repulsive Harmonic Oscillator with Application to the Schwinger Effect
